summary_1line: Sanjaya explains the elements, life forms, and a mythic cosmology of Earth centered on Mount Meru and the seven regions of the world.

image_candidates.scene_text: The golden Mount Meru rises like a sunlit pillar while the sun and moon circle it and celestial beings gather on its radiant slopes.
The river Ganga bursts from the summit of the mountain and crashes downward like a stream of milk while Shiva holds its force in his hair.
A circular island world ringed by ocean appears in the lunar disc, its land shaped like a peepul tree and a hare.
